text: [x]Battlecry: Start a three turn lunar cycle. When the Full Moon rises, your cards cost (1) this game.

abilities.label: BATTLECRY
abilities.span: Battlecry: Start a three turn lunar cycle. When the Full Moon rises, your cards cost (1) this game.

dependencies.detail: Whether cards created into hand or deck after the Full Moon also cost (1). uses ALL_MATCHING encodes yes; the user observed hand and deck, not newly created cards.
dependencies.source_needed: Power.log or play-test: generate a card after the Full Moon and read its cost

dependencies.detail: A second Aviana Battlecry (second cycle, second effect) is not established; the declaration encodes one independent effect per Battlecry.
dependencies.source_needed: Power.log or play-test of a second Aviana

dependencies.detail: Interactions with other cost modifiers beyond the general R_COST order are not established (e.g. a modifier applied after the Full Moon).
dependencies.source_needed: Power.log of another cost modifier after the Full Moon

decisions.question: Whose turns advance the three-turn lunar cycle?
decisions.discriminating_case: Battlecry on your turn T: counting own turns the Full Moon rises on your turn T+3; counting every turn it would rise on the opponent's turn T+1 already.

decisions.question: At which boundary does the Full Moon rise?
alternatives: at the start of your third turn after the Battlecry
at the end of your third turn after the Battlecry
decisions.chosen: at the start of your third turn after the Battlecry
decisions.discriminating_case: On your third turn after the Battlecry a 9-cost card in hand costs (1) from that turn's start under the chosen reading and still 9 during that turn under the alternative.

decisions.question: Which of your cards cost (1)?
decisions.discriminating_case: After the Full Moon a 7-cost card in the deck: 'draw your highest-cost card' effects see 1 under hand and deck, 7 under hand only.

decisions.question: Do cards created after the Full Moon cost (1)?
alternatives: no (only cards present at the Full Moon)
decisions.discriminating_case: A card discovered into hand after the Full Moon costs (1) under yes and its printed cost under no.

decisions.question: How long do the costs stay (1)?
decisions.discriminating_case: Aviana dies after the Full Moon: under 'this game' cards still cost (1).

notes: CARD-IR-V02 expressivity example, not a B1 re-compilation. User-observed facts: three own turns, hand and deck cost (1), until the end of the game.
